main.content:
==English==

===Etymology===
From {{inh|en|enm|deliveri}} et al., from {{der|en|xno|-}}, from {{der|en|fro|delivrer}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/dɪˈlɪv.(ə.)ɹi/|a=RP,GA,CA,AU}} 
** {{audio|en|en-au-delivery.ogg|a=AU}}
* {{rhymes|en|ɪvəɹi|s=4}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun|~}}

# {{senseid|en|conveying}} The act of [[convey]]ing something.
#: {{ux|en|The '''delivery''' was completed by four.}}
#: {{ux|en|'''delivery''' of a nuclear missile to its target}}
# The item which has been conveyed.
#: {{syn|en|consignment}}
#: {{ux|en|Your '''delivery''' is on the table.}}
# {{senseid|en|Q34581 or component thereof}} {{lb|en|medicine|obstetrics}} The act or process of a mother giving [[birth]].
#: {{cot|en|labour<id:Q34581 or component thereof><qq:the process leading up>}}
#: {{nearsyn|en|childbirth<id:Q34581>|parturition<id:Q34581>}}
#: {{ux|en|The '''delivery''' was painful.}}
# {{lb|en|baseball}} A pitching motion.
#: {{ux|en|His '''delivery''' has a catch in it.}}
# {{lb|en|baseball}} A thrown pitch.
#: {{ux|en|Here is the '''delivery'''; ... strike three!}}
# The manner of speaking or singing.
#: {{ux|en|The actor's '''delivery''' was flawless.}}
#* {{RQ:Maugham Moon and Sixpence|[[s:The Moon and Sixpence/Chapter LV|chapter 55]]||I shall not tell what Dr. Coutras related to me in his words, but in my own, for I cannot hope to give at second hand any impression of his vivacious '''delivery'''.}}
#* {{quote-journal
|1=en
|date=June 3, 2012
|author=Nathan Rabin
|title=TV: Review: THE SIMPSONS (CLASSIC): “Mr. Plow” (season 4, episode 9; originally aired 11/19/1992)
|url=http://www.avclub.com/articles/mr-plow,75560/
|page=
|passage=Half of the comedy in West’s self-deprecating appearance on “{{w|Mr. Plow}}” comes from the veteran actor’s purring, self-satisfied '''delivery''' as he tells a deeply unnerved Bart and Lisa of the newfangled, less groovy cinematic Batman
|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20121026042752/http://www.avclub.com/articles/mr-plow,75560/
|archivedate=26 October 2012}}
# {{lb|en|medicine}} The [[administration]] of a [[drug]].
#: {{ux|en|drug '''delivery''' system}}
# {{lb|en|cricket}} A [[ball]] [[bowl#Verb|bowled]].
# {{lb|en|curling}} The process of throwing a [[stone]].
# {{lb|en|genetics}} Process of introducing foreign DNA into host cells.
# {{lb|en|football}} A [[cross]] or [[pass]]
#* {{quote-web|en|date=June 29 2021|author=Phil McNulty|work=BBC Sport|title=England 2-0 Germany|url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/51198606|passage=The win was secured with another moment of significance four minutes from time when captain {{w|Harry Kane}}, who had once again struggled to influence the game, headed in from substitute {{w|Jack Grealish}}'s perfect '''delivery''' for his first goal of {{w|Euro 2020}}.|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20260211231932/https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/51198606|archivedate=11 February 2026}}
